findings: Effective native partitionable setting is False in JAX 0.4.38 on nvidia6 and True in JAX 0.6.2 on nvidia7; both use threefry2x32 and seed offset zero.
Native environments differ bitwise in split keys, raw bits, float32/float64 uniform and normal samples, and permutations. Initial key and fold_in(7) agree.
JAX 0.6.2 with partitionable=False matches JAX 0.4.38 bit-for-bit for all nine fingerprints in this probe.
This isolates a software RNG confound independently of GPU vendor and can change seeded initializations and sampling paths before any training.
No AMD probe or training trial was performed here. These checks neither quantify final metric effects nor establish that this flag explains all observed experiment differences.

historical_documentation.limitation: Repository setup documentation is provenance evidence, not a captured original experiment environment. requirements.txt separately names JAX 0.4.28.

method.hash_encoding: SHA256 of contiguous C-order ndarray bytes; all probed hosts little-endian.
method.key_reuse_note: Every operation deliberately receives the same seed key as a standalone fingerprint; this is not a training sampling recipe.

official_sources.claim: Maintainer upgrade note describes changed random values and restoring the previous behavior with partitionable=False.
